morphology.pattern_note: 外语地名，整词记忆，不按马来语词缀拆分。所列 IPA 为荷兰语读音；马来语交谈中的读法可能不同。

senses.zh_definition: 荷兰西部的历史地区，现主要对应北荷兰省与南荷兰省。
senses.en_definition: A historical region in the western Netherlands, principally corresponding to North Holland and South Holland.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas bagi wilayah bersejarah di bahagian barat Belanda yang kini terutama merangkumi wilayah Holland Utara dan Holland Selatan.
senses.nuances: 属于专有名词，规范书写为 Holland。输入包未提供 DBP 释义，此处为地名说明。严格地理意义上的 Holland 只指荷兰的一部分。[荷兰国家旅游局说明](https://www.holland.com/global/tourism/getting-around/information/netherlands-vs-holland)

senses.zh_definition: 荷兰；在非正式或传统用法中，以 Holland 泛指整个荷兰国家。
senses.en_definition: An informal or traditional name for the Netherlands as a whole.
senses.ms_definition: Sebutan tidak rasmi atau tradisional yang digunakan untuk merujuk kepada negara Belanda secara keseluruhan.
senses.nuances: 这是以地区代指国家的用法；马来语正式国名通常用 Belanda。以下搭配展示非正式用法，不表示 Holland 是首选正式国名。[荷兰国家旅游局说明](https://www.holland.com/global/tourism/getting-around/information/netherlands-vs-holland)

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Lawatan kerja itu meliputi beberapa bandar di Holland Utara dan Holland Selatan, Belanda.
dual_scenarios.zh: 此次工作访问涵盖荷兰北荷兰省与南荷兰省的数座城市。
dual_scenarios.en: The working visit covers several cities in North Holland and South Holland in the Netherlands.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Kau nak pergi Holland bulan depan ke?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Adakah kamu hendak pergi ke Belanda pada bulan hadapan?
dual_scenarios.en: Are you going to Holland next month?

messages.ms_standard: Adakah kamu hendak pergi ke Belanda pada bulan hadapan?

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)

messages.ms_standard: Ya, saya sudah membeli tiket. Saya hendak singgah di Amsterdam terlebih dahulu.

messages.en: Yeah, I've bought the tickets. I want to stop in Amsterdam first.

etymology.historical_story: Holland became internationally familiar through the economic and cultural prominence of its historical region. Its name consequently came to stand for the entire Netherlands in everyday foreign usage. The geographical distinction remains useful: North Holland and South Holland represent only part of the country, although their internationally prominent cities help explain the broader name's persistence. [Source: Netherlands Board of Tourism](https://www.holland.com/global/tourism/getting-around/information/netherlands-vs-holland)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Holland 与“荷兰”连起来，再记住两块地图：北荷兰、南荷兰；地区名称常被借来称整个国家。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 正式马来语文件介绍整个国家时优先使用 Belanda；介绍具体地区时使用 Holland 并说明范围。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 与荷兰人交谈时，留意对方来自哪个地区；涉及地理身份时，不宜默认所有荷兰人都来自 Holland。
